test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.**

If we want to progress, we must sometimes embrace __ __ (mutate).
solution: The correct answer is **change**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Mutate: **to change into a new form. (नवीन रूप धारण करना, परिवर्तित होना) • **Change:** to become different or to make somebody/something different. (बदलना, परिवर्तन करना) • Thus, the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Replicate: **to copy something exactly. (किसी वस्‍तु की प्रतिकृति या हूबहू नक़ल करना या बनाना) • **Imitate: **to copy the behaviour of somebody/something. (किसी के आचरण की नक़ल करना; अनुकरण करना) • **Incise: **mark or decorate (an object or surface) with a cut or cuts. (उत्कीर्ण करना; काटना) 3e:Ta6a, The correct answer is **"No substitution"**
